Subject: Authorization: bridge premium & sign-on package for Senior Research hire (N. Alvarez)

Team — quick ask for an out-of-band authorization so we can close Nina Alvarez (senior research engineer, IC3). Recruiting flagged a competing offer that went live this morning; candidate wants a decision today. Hiring manager (Ben Carter) recommends we go above band to secure her. Details below and attached: comp_band_reference_2026.csv + draft offer (nina_alvarez_offer_package_v2.pdf).

Summary ask
- Base: $210,000 (Senior Research band top = $190,000) — 10% above top-of-band
- Sign-on: $40,000 (paid over 12 months)
- Equity: 5,000 RSUs cliff 1y / 3y remaining schedule (refresh slot request)
- Start window: December 6–20 (candidate prefers earlier)

Rationale
- Strong ML research profile; active offers from two FAANG-equivalent teams (recruit says total comp parity at ~ $300–320k)
- Manager escalated: product roadmaps have a critical dependency on her research area for Q1 deliverable
- Time pressure: candidate asked for an offer by COB Fri 11/19 to decide

Risks/controls
- Requesting explicit approval for bridge premium (10% over band) only for this candidate; will not change band policy
- If approved, recruiting will issue an offer with a 7-day validity and include standard clawback for sign-on if <6 months tenure

Requested approvals (please reply with either APPROVE / APPROVE w/ MOD / DENY):
1) Laura — overall comp envelope (base + sign-on + equity)
2) Markus — finance confirmation on funding source (headcount vs discretionary hiring fund)
3) Lauren — people ops approval for out-of-band sign-on structure

Attachments: nina_alvarez_offer_package_v2.pdf (draft offer), comp_band_reference_2026.csv

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee

If both are true Im OK to APPROVE the bridge premium (base $210k) with the adjusted sign-on split.
